pr_title: drivers: watchdog: mcux_wwdt: add driver for NXP LPC 55xxx WWDT
pr_body:
Adds shim driver for LPC 55xxx Windowed Watchdog Timer (WWDT).

Also updates the "Supported features" table in LPCXpresso55S69
board documentation page.

Signed-off-by: Jiří Keresteš <jiri@kerestes.cz>

issue_context.title: Implement watchdog driver for lpcxpresso55s69
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
The `lpcxpresso55s69` board currently lacks support for watchdog in zephyr.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Implement a shim driver that adapts the mcux lpc wwdt driver to the zephyr watchdog interface. The existing `wdt_mcux_wdog.c` and `wdt_mcux_wdog32.c` shim drivers for kinetis and i.mx rt can be used for reference. Enable `tests/drivers/watchdog` for this board to ensure the watchdog driver builds and functions correctly.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A

**Additional context**
N/A
comments:
Here is PR for NXP HAL, that builds relevant HAL driver when shim driver is enabled: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/hal_nxp/pull/48

I also have a working shim driver for the watchdog, I'll create PR for that soon (after some clean-up).

No problem :)

Promised PR for shim driver: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/26779

`samples/drivers/watchdog` works on LPCXpresso55S69 board, but I'm not 100% sure about Kconfig related stuff.

review_comments: why us DT macro here v CONFIG_WDT_MCUX_WWDT?
I2C and SPI clocks are both set up using DT macros, so I did the same thing here. I'm not sure if DT macros are better than CONFIG_WDT_MCUX_WWDT option, should I change it?
